question: For dye decolorization by the Cu2O-Ag loofah monolith, what optimum conditions did response surface methodology find, and what decolorization efficiency was predicted and then measured?
expect: pH 5.94, 68.07 mg/L dye, 0.71 g monolith; predicted 98.14%, validated 96.43% (abstract)
rendered:
Document: "Acrylic-assisted immobilization of Cu2O-Ag domains on a 3D loofah monolith for adsorption-assisted visible-light photodecolorization"

The optimum conditions for dye decolorization by the Cu2O-Ag loofah monolith were found to be pH 5.94, an initial dye concentration of 68.07 mg L^−1, and a monolith dosage of 0.71 g.

Response surface methodology predicted a decolorization efficiency of 98.14% under these conditions. The experimentally validated decolorization efficiency was 96.43%.
